{"code":"function solve(a,b){function eq(x,y){if(x===y)return true;if(typeof x!==typeof y||x===null||y===null)return false;if(typeof x!=='object')return false;var ax=Array.isArray(x),ay=Array.isArray(y);if(ax!==ay)return false;if(ax){if(x.length!==y.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<x.length;i++)if(!eq(x[i],y[i]))return false;return true}var kx=Object.keys(x),ky=Object.keys(y);if(kx.length!==ky.length)return false;for(var j=0;j<kx.length;j++){var k=kx[j];if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(y,k)||!eq(x[k],y[k]))return false}return true}return eq(a,b)}"}

{"code":"function solve(a,b){if(a===b)return true;if(typeof a!==typeof b||a===null||b===null||typeof a!==\"object\")return false;var aa=Array.isArray(a),bb=Array.isArray(b);if(aa!==bb)return false;if(aa){if(a.length!==b.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!solve(a[i],b[i]))return false;return true}var ka=Object.keys(a),kb=Object.keys(b);if(ka.length!==kb.length)return false;for(var j=0;j<ka.length;j++){var k=ka[j];if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||!solve(a[k],b[k]))return false}return true}"}

{"code":"function solve(document,pointer){if(pointer==='')return document;var parts=pointer.split('/').slice(1),current=document;for(var i=0;i<parts.length;i++){var key=parts[i].replace(/~1/g,'/').replace(/~0/g,'~');if(Array.isArray(current)){if(!/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(key))return null;var index=Number(key);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(index)||index>=current.length)return null;current=current[index];}else if(current!==null&&typeof current==='object'){if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current,key))return null;current=current[key];}else{return null;}}return current===undefined?null:current;}"}

{"code":"function solve(matrix){const rows=matrix.length,cols=matrix[0].length,result=[];let top=0,bottom=rows-1,left=0,right=cols-1;while(top<=bottom&&left<=right){for(let c=left;c<=right;c++)result.push(matrix[top][c]);top++;for(let r=top;r<=bottom;r++)result.push(matrix[r][right]);right--;if(top<=bottom){for(let c=right;c>=left;c--)result.push(matrix[bottom][c]);bottom--;}if(left<=right){for(let r=bottom;r>=top;r--)result.push(matrix[r][left]);left++;}}return result;}"}

{"code":"function solve(text,pattern){let t=0,p=0,star=-1,mark=0;while(t<text.length){if(p<pattern.length&&(pattern[p]==='?'||pattern[p]===text[t])){t++;p++;}else if(p<pattern.length&&pattern[p]==='*'){star=p++;mark=t;}else if(star!==-1){p=star+1;t=++mark;}else return false;}while(p<pattern.length&&pattern[p]==='*')p++;return p===pattern.length;}"}

{"code":"function solve(grid,row,col,color){const h=grid.length,w=grid[0].length,target=grid[row][col];if(target===color)return grid.map(r=>r.slice());const out=grid.map(r=>r.slice()),seen=Array.from({length:h},()=>Array(w).fill(false)),stack=[[row,col]];seen[row][col]=true;while(stack.length){const p=stack.pop(),r=p[0],c=p[1];out[r][c]=color;if(r>0&&!seen[r-1][c]&&grid[r-1][c]===target){seen[r-1][c]=true;stack.push([r-1,c]);}if(r+1<h&&!seen[r+1][c]&&grid[r+1][c]===target){seen[r+1][c]=true;stack.push([r+1,c]);}if(c>0&&!seen[r][c-1]&&grid[r][c-1]===target){seen[r][c-1]=true;stack.push([r,c-1]);}if(c+1<w&&!seen[r][c+1]&&grid[r][c+1]===target){seen[r][c+1]=true;stack.push([r,c+1]);}}return out;}"}
{"code":"function solve(tree){const result=[];function walk(node){if(node===null)return;walk(node.left);result.push(node.value);walk(node.right);}walk(tree);return result;}"}

{"code":"function solve(n,edges){var p=[],i,u,v;for(i=0;i<n;i++)p[i]=i;function f(x){while(p[x]!==x){p[x]=p[p[x]];x=p[x];}return x;}for(i=0;i<edges.length;i++){u=f(edges[i][0]);v=f(edges[i][1]);if(u!==v)p[u]=v;}var c=0;for(i=0;i<n;i++)if(f(i)===i)c++;return c;}"}

{"code":"function solve(document,pointer){if(pointer===\"\")return document;var parts=pointer.split(\"/\");var current=document;for(var i=1;i<parts.length;i++){var token=parts[i].replace(/~1/g,\"/\").replace(/~0/g,\"~\");if(current===null||typeof current!==\"object\")return null;if(Array.isArray(current)){if(!/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(token))return null;var index=Number(token);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(index)||index>=current.length)return null;current=current[index];}else{if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current,token))return null;current=current[token];}}return current===undefined?null:current;}"}
